An important distinction for the N2 exam is that the kanji 脅かす has two readings: 「おびやかす」means threatening abstract things such as survival or status, while 「おどかす」(usually written as 脅かす or 驚かす) refers to specifically intimidating someone or making someone startled and frightened.

default.q.test-91-q9-9.explanation: The intransitive Group 1 verb 「異なる」（ことなる）means “to differ” or “to be different.” It has a formal tone and is more common in written language or polite speech than 「違う」, and frequently appears in the pattern 「～によって異なる」(differ depending on...). The complete sentence 「文化は国によって異なる。」means: “Cultures differ from country to country.” Another common example is: 「世代によって価値観が大きく異なる。」(Values differ greatly between generations.)
